xBRIEFInfo.description: Wave 5 of #2948: walk-away finish-loop tasks consuming Wave 0+1+4 grants (#871)

narratives.Description: Wave 5 of #2948. Implement task directive:finish-loop and task pr:finish-loop as the walk-away product. Every high-blast step routes through Wave 1 human-origin grants and Wave 4 closed-verb gates (finish-loop template). Halt cleanly on grant expiry, exhaustion, or scope refusal. Heartbeat to .deft-cache/finish-loop-progress.jsonl. Do not invent a second mint path. Compose with pr:watch, review-cycle, and existing scope lifecycle.
narratives.UserStory: As an operator, I want finish-loop grant templates and directive and pr finish-loop tasks, so that I can walk away while authorized implement PR review merge continues until the queue is empty.
narratives.ImplementationPlan: Step 1: Add finish-loop verb rows / authz template that mints operator-cli grants covering implement edit push pr merge closure verbs needed for the loop (map to Wave 1 AuthzOperation + closed-verb where applicable). Step 2: packages/core finish-loop engine: iterate active/pending queue (or plan-sequence), implement boundary is agent-owned — CLI orchestrates gates + progress log + BLOCKED messages. Step 3: pr:finish-loop wraps pr:watch until CLEAN then optional wait-mergeable-and-merge when policy allows (respect requireHumanMerge). Step 4: directive:finish-loop outer loop calls pr:finish-loop per PR, logs progress, stops on empty queue / grant fail / max iterations. Step 5: CLI routes + Taskfile + content/contracts/finish-loop.md + CHANGELOG #871 #2948. Tests for grant-required, progress append, halt conditions. drive-to: merge-ready.
narratives.Traces: Wave 5 #871 AC of #2948; consumes Wave 1+4 grants

narrative.Acceptance: When authz:grant uses template finish-loop, mintHumanOriginGrant returns an operator-cli grant covering loop operations and unit tests reject agent-authored grants as authorization.

items.title: pr:finish-loop watches and addresses until CLEAN

narrative.Acceptance: When grants are present, pr:finish-loop returns CLEAN via pr:watch integration and when grants are missing the command fails closed with a BLOCKED code.
Given an authorized finish-loop session, directive:finish-loop appends finish-loop-progress.jsonl per iteration and stops when the queue is empty or a gate returns deny.
content/contracts/finish-loop.md records the walk-away path and CHANGELOG Unreleased records #871 under #2948 Wave 5.
